title: 奎因·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深色短发配蓝银铠甲与蓝披风，鹰伙伴保留独立身体。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Quinn is an adult ranger with short dark hair, focused eyes, blue-and-silver armor, a blue cape, and a compact crossbow secured behind her. Valor is a large blue-feathered eagle with a pale beak, distinct wings, and an anatomically separate bird body; preserve their human-and-bird partnership.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: cobalt, silver gray, feather teal, warm stone, sky ivory; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
